name: The 25-Mile Forecast Board
note: Questions resolve by a reviewed edit: set resolution to {outcome: true|false, resolvedAt, sourceUrl, note}, or {outcome: null, void: true, ...} when the source never settles it. Sources were read Nov 8 to 9, 2026.

questions.question: Will the LA Kings win at least 3 of their 7 games from Nov 10 through Nov 23, 2026 (regulation, OT or shootout wins all count)?
questions.yesMeans: Kings record 3 or more wins across the games on Nov 10, 12, 14, 17, 19, 21 and 23.
questions.noMeans: The Kings win 2 or fewer of those games.
questions.context: Three home games (Nashville, Islanders, Calgary), then a four-game road trip to Boston, Toronto, Ottawa and Montreal.

questions.question: Will SpaceX launch at least 6 Falcon 9 missions from Vandenberg between Nov 12 and Nov 30, 2026 (Pacific time)?
questions.yesMeans: Six or more Falcon 9 liftoffs from Vandenberg (SLC-4E) occur from 12:00 AM PT Nov 12 through 11:59 PM PT Nov 30, 2026.
questions.context: Vandenberg has been flying about one Falcon 9 every 3 to 4 days since mid-October (Spaceflight Now, read Nov 8).

source.name: SpaceNexus Vandenberg launch schedule and Spaceflight Now Falcon 9 category

questions.question: Will LAX (KLAX) record measurable rain (0.01 inch or more) on any day from Nov 12 through Nov 20, 2026?
questions.yesMeans: NWS climate data for Los Angeles Airport shows at least 0.01 inch of precipitation on at least one day from Nov 12 to Nov 20, 2026.
questions.noMeans: No day in that window has 0.01 inch or more (only a trace or none).
questions.context: The NWS forecast issued Nov 8 was dry and warm through Nov 12, with only a slight chance of rain Nov 13 and 14.

source.name: NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard climate report for LAX (CLM) and point forecast

questions.question: Will LAX record at least 0.50 inch of rain for all of November 2026?
questions.yesMeans: The NWS monthly climate summary for LAX shows November 2026 precipitation of 0.50 inch or more.
questions.context: The November normal at LAX is under an inch, and one storm usually decides the month.

source.name: NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard climate report for LAX (CLM; November summary issued Dec 1)

questions.question: Will NDBC buoy 46221 (Santa Monica Bay) report a significant wave height of 5.0 ft or more in any hourly observation from Nov 12 through Dec 10, 2026?
questions.yesMeans: At least one hourly observation in the NDBC station history for 46221 shows WVHT of 5.0 ft or higher between Nov 12 and Dec 10, 2026 (PST).
questions.noMeans: All observations in that period are below 5.0 ft.
questions.context: The Santa Monica Bay buoy read 3.3 ft at 14 seconds early Nov 8. The Channel Islands shelter the bay, so it takes a real winter swell to pass 5 ft.

questions.question: Will SpaceX launch the USSF-317 mission on a Falcon 9 from Vandenberg by 11:59 PM PT on Sunday, Nov 15, 2026?
questions.yesMeans: Liftoff of USSF-317 from Vandenberg occurs on or before 11:59 PM PT Nov 15, 2026.
questions.noMeans: It has not lifted off by then (delay or scrub).
questions.context: Listed as Go for 8:23 PM PST Thursday, Nov 12 (read Nov 8). USSF-627 goes first, Monday Nov 9 at 7:03 PM PST.

source.name: SpaceNexus Vandenberg launch schedule (cross-check Spaceflight Now)

questions.question: Will Ryan Baldino finish in the top two (a winning seat) in the certified El Segundo City Council results from the Nov 3, 2026 election?
questions.yesMeans: In the LA County Registrar's certified results for El Segundo City Council (vote for two), Ryan Baldino's vote total is among the two highest of the three candidates (Pickhaver, Pimentel, Baldino).
questions.noMeans: Baldino finishes third in the certified results.
questions.context: Two seats are open. In the counts read Nov 5 to 8, Ryan W. Baldino ran third, under 200 votes behind second place, with late ballots still being counted.

source.name: NBC Los Angeles / LA County Registrar election results (certified results at results.lavote.gov)

questions.question: Will Measure CT (El Segundo business license tax on non-charitable nonprofits) receive at least 82.0% Yes in the certified LA County results?
questions.yesMeans: Certified Yes share for Measure CT is 82.0% or higher.
questions.context: Measure CT needs a simple majority. Early counts had it near 83% Yes, so this asks whether the margin holds.

source.name: NBC Los Angeles / LA County Registrar election results

questions.question: Will the LA County Registrar-Recorder certify the Nov 3, 2026 general election results on or before Wednesday, Nov 25, 2026?
questions.yesMeans: LA County's certified final results are posted/announced dated Nov 25, 2026 or earlier.
questions.noMeans: Certification is dated Nov 26, 2026 or later.
questions.context: LAist (read Nov 8) says the county is scheduled to certify by Friday, Nov 27, with count updates on Nov 17, 19, 25 and 27.

source.name: LAist live results page (county schedule); lavote.gov results for the certification stamp

questions.question: Will LAWA's 2026 Thanksgiving travel news release project a single busiest day above 230,000 passengers at LAX?
questions.yesMeans: The 2026 LAWA Thanksgiving news release (or LAX press materials) names a busiest day with more than 230,000 expected passengers.
questions.noMeans: The named busiest day is 230,000 or fewer, or no such figure is given.
questions.context: The 2025 release named the Sunday after Thanksgiving as the busiest day, at 230,000+. LAX traffic was down about 1% year to date through July 2026.

source.name: LAWA news release (2025 edition opened as the precedent)

questions.question: Will LAWA's traffic comparison report for October 2026 show calendar-year-to-date LAX passengers below the same period of 2025?
questions.yesMeans: The LAWA TCOM report for October 2026, published by Dec 15, 2026, shows Jan-Oct 2026 LAX total passengers lower than Jan-Oct 2025.
questions.noMeans: It shows equal or higher, or the report is not published by Dec 15.
questions.context: The July 2026 report, the latest found, showed year-to-date passengers down 1.10% from 2025.

source.name: LAWA Traffic Comparison (TCOM) report, July 2026 edition (latest I could open)

questions.question: Will the Los Angeles Rams beat the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday, Nov 15, 2026?
questions.yesMeans: The Rams win the road game at Arizona on Nov 15, 2026 (final score on ESPN/NFL.com).
questions.noMeans: The Rams lose or tie, or the game is not played that day.
questions.context: Road game. The Cardinals beat the Rams 18-16 in LA on Oct 18.

questions.question: Will El Segundo hold its postponed Vision 2050 General Plan Land Use Element study session on or before Dec 31, 2026?
questions.yesMeans: A Vision 2050 study session is held between Nov 12 and Dec 31, 2026, as shown by an agenda or minutes on elsegundo.gov.
questions.noMeans: No such session is held by Dec 31, 2026.
questions.context: The city bulletin sent Nov 2 says the Nov 17 study session is postponed, with no new date. A new council is seated in December.

source.name: City of El Segundo November 2026 City News bulletin (GovDelivery)

questions.question: Will the Los Angeles Chargers beat the New York Jets on Sunday, Nov 22, 2026?
questions.yesMeans: The Chargers win the regular-season game vs the Jets on Nov 22, 2026 (official final score on ESPN/NFL.com).
questions.noMeans: The Chargers lose or tie, or the game is not played that day.
questions.context: Home game at SoFi. Check the Chargers record on ESPN before you forecast.

questions.question: Will the El Segundo City Council certify the Nov 3 election and swear in the newly elected members at a meeting held on or before Tuesday, Dec 15, 2026?
questions.yesMeans: A City Council meeting dated Dec 15, 2026 or earlier adopts the election certification and swears in the council members elected on Nov 3 (per the agenda/minutes or a city press release).
questions.noMeans: That meeting takes place after Dec 15, 2026 (or is not held by then).
questions.context: In 2024 the council certified the election and swore in members on Tuesday, Dec 17. County certification is due Nov 27 this year.

source.name: City of El Segundo Agendas & Minutes (City Clerk)
